address: Via ai Monti della Trinità 44, Locarno, 6600, Switzerland
bio: Splendidly located inside the Hotel Belvedere, at an altitude of approximately 240m, this elegant south-facing restaurant boasts a splendid terrace and a lounge space. Depending on where you sit, watch the chef at work in the kitchen or enjoy the impressive views through La Fontana’s ground floor picture windows overlooking its verdant surroundings. The culinary focus here is on modern and seasonal Mediterranean cuisine without neglecting the region’s gastronomic roots. In addition to the classic menu, you can also choose the 4- or 5-course tasting option as well as the restaurant’s signature dishes such as the La Fontana tartare, the Chateaubriand, and the Raviolini del Plin. The extensive glass-fronted wine cabinets at the entrance provide an impressive backdrop....
